# core-v1_branch_diff_response (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Group for the resource diff.
- `hash` (String) Branch head hash; response is only returned if this matches the current branch state.
- `kind` (String) Kind for the resource diff.
- `name` (String) Name for the resource diff.
- `version` (String) Version for the resource diff.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace for the resource diff. Required if the resource is namespaced.

### Read-Only

- `after` (String) After is the YAML form of the CR's current state (empty string for deletes).
- `before` (String) Before is the YAML form of the CR's prior state (empty string if there was no prior state).
